articles.summary: HOUSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026-- The Board of Directors of Murphy Oil Corporation (NYSE: MUR) today declared a quarterly cash dividend on the Common Stock of Murphy Oil Corporation of $0.35 per share, or $1.40 per share on an annualized basis.
